# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 and performance** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the bundled engine to Skia m151. It adds .NET 11 WebAssembly support, accelerates color conversion and text shaping, and restores CPU raster performance. SKColor hex parsing now rejects whitespace immediately after `#`; check the breaking change before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **SKColor hex parsing rejects whitespace after the hash** — SKColor.Parse and TryParse no longer accept whitespace immediately after `#` in six- and eight-digit hex colors. Remove that whitespace before parsing. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — Updates the bundled renderer from Chrome milestone 150 to milestone 151 without changing the generated C# binding surface. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294))

## API Surface

- **Span-based parsing added** — Adds ReadOnlySpan<char> parsing overloads for SKColor, SKFourByteTag, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag, avoiding substring creation when parsing slices. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408))
- **GRContextOptions no longer requires unsafe** — Removes the unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions for easier use in safe code. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Bug Fixes

- **CPU raster performance restored** — Restores the optimized shader context for scaled and tiled bitmap drawing, addressing high CPU use, frame drops, and flicker. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))
- **Ganesh rendering state corrected** — Includes upstream fixes for stencil clears in native coordinates and preserve mode, plus dirty tracking after a failed resolve task. ([#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))
- **Corrupt Slug cleanup fixed** — Prevents a use-after-free and invalid free while rejecting a corrupt serialized Slug buffer. ([#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Single-color conversions accelerated** — Moves SKColor to SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiplication and unpremultiplication to managed math, removing per-call native transitions. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **Text shaping overhead reduced** — Reads SKShaper glyph results through zero-copy spans and uses pooled UTF-8 encoding in HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string). ([#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376))
- **Intermediate decoded images released promptly** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) now disposes the full-size intermediate image when a subset returns a different image. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Platform

- **.NET 11 WebAssembly supported** — Ships Emscripten 5.0.6 native assets for .NET 11 and builds them with the matching exnref exception model, fixing link and browser startup failures. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 adds span-based Tag parsing, removes its scratch-buffer overhead, and uses pooled UTF-8 encoding in Buffer.AddUtf8(string).

## Release Candidate 1 (July 21, 2026)

Adds .NET 11 WebAssembly libraries and compatible exception handling, and restores fast CPU rasterization for scaled and tiled bitmaps. Speeds single-color conversions, fixes intermediate SKImage disposal, and includes Ganesh stencil and resolve fixes. ## Preview 2 (July 14, 2026)

Tightens SKColor hex parsing by rejecting whitespace after `#` and adds span-based parsing for SKColor, SKFourByteTag, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.
